items.headline: Cook, Hawkins lead West Virginia over Coastal Carolina 31-24
items.description: — Cam Cook rushed for 142 yards and two short touchdowns, Michael Hawkins Jr. threw for one score and passed for another TD, and West Virginia held on for a 31-24 win over Coastal Carolina in the teams’ season opener Saturday.
